synthesis.description: Users report errors in operations and trading systems: bridge-back errors on meters for a production month, bad numbers in POPS, failed scrapes, Unify database hangs, duplicate Sitara deals and position manager faults. Support or IT investigates and fixes them, while IT also announces outages, releases, URL and server changes and EOL rollouts, sometimes with steps users must take such as rebooting or mapping a drive. Users collect enhancement requests and confirm releases look right from the commercial side.
steps: A user notices an error, such as a bridge-back error, bad volumes or a failed import, and reports it with the meter, deal or date.
Support investigates the cause in the affected system.
Data is corrected, such as killing a duplicate Sitara deal or re-running a bridge.
IT announces outages, releases or configuration changes and any user action needed.
Users test or confirm the fix or release and report remaining issues.
Recurring problems are listed as enhancement requests for later releases.
synthesis.approach: Automated monitoring of bridge jobs and scrapes that flags failed meters, deals and runs to the owning team, a single outage and release calendar with required user actions, and a known-issues guide for common desktop errors.
synthesis.rationale: Much of the hands-on time goes to spotting and correcting recurring bridge errors and diagnosing known desktop faults. A written procedure for triage and correction, backed by exception reports, shortens each round and routes issues to the right owner.
